title: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary: In 2076, the Moon is a penal colony ruled from Earth. A computer technician, a self-aware computer named Mike and a small group of revolutionaries plot a rebellion for independence.
readIf: you like idea-driven science fiction about revolution and libertarian politics.
skipIf: you dislike dated gender roles and long political discussions in fiction.
